text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah (Perbekalan) 2025.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2026

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua belas juta sembilan ratus

enam puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM12,964,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Suri Rumah bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial

Suri Rumah bagi tahun 2026 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 3,842,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 6,042,000

 Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 862,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,095,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 1,123,000

JUMLAH 12,964,000

Dibuat 20 Disember 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(8); PN(PU2)765/JLD.2]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2022

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 54(1) of

the Housewives' Social Security Act 2022 [Act 838], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Housewives' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2025.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2026

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding twelve million nine hundred sixty four thousand

ringgit (RM12,964,000) from the Housewives' Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Housewives' Social Security Scheme for

the year 2026 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 3,842,000

Supplies and services 6,042,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 862,000

Other expenditures 1,095,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 1,123,000

TOTAL 12,964,000

Made 20 December 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(8); PN(PU2)765/JLD.2]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Minister of Human Resources
